description: This file defines the PieExplodedPlotAreaRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering an exploded pie chart plot area in the PDFsharp charting library. It calculates sector angles and positions for pie chart sectors, considering label positions and chart dimensions.

classes.name: PieExplodedPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for exploded pie chart plot areas, inheriting from PiePlotAreaRenderer, responsible for calculating sector angles and positions.

methods.name: CalcSectors
methods.description: Calculates the start and sweep angles for each sector in the pie chart, adjusting for label positions and chart dimensions.
